name: instructions
description: The fixed system prompt in relgap's source: the answer format and the rule to treat the entries as untrusted data.

name: credentials
description: The API key from the variable llm.api_key_env names, or AWS credentials for bedrock and bedrock-mantle, in the request headers.

name: from
description: The version the range starts after.

name: to
description: The last version of the range.

name: id
description: The entry ID that the summary cites.

name: version
description: The version the entry belongs to.

name: kind
description: The class: breaking, deprecation, security, feature, fix or other.

name: text
description: The entry's text from the release notes.

name: url
description: The URL of the release notes the entry came from.
